visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up view of small, circular yellow corn cakes sizzling on a flat metallic griddle. A pair of wooden tongs is used to move them. The scene transitions to a metal tray filled with dozens of these golden-brown finished cakes. (2) A young man with black glasses and a baseball cap holds a warm corn cake to the camera. He stands in front of a vibrant red storefront sign. He takes a large, enthusiastic bite while a friend watches in the background. (3) Inside a cramped kitchen stall, a worker in a yellow shirt and white apron lifts heavy metal steamer trays. A woman in a green polo shirt laughs beside him. The background is filled with stacked stainless steel steamer pots. (4) Extreme close-up of a large metal bowl containing thick, pale yellow corn batter. A large metal spoon scoops the mixture into small, individual round molds on a greased griddle. Oil bubbles around the edges of the batter. (5) The worker in the yellow shirt uses a flat spatula to quickly scrape cooked corn cakes off the hot surface. The environment is utilitarian with high-density storage of cooking equipment and raw ingredients in the background. (6) A close-up of a hand holding a half-eaten corn cake, revealing a soft, porous yellow interior. The camera then focuses on the man's fingers, which are visibly glistening with oil, highlighting the greasy nature of the snack. (7) A woman in a light-colored floral dress takes a bite of the cake. Her expression is one of pleasant surprise. The final shot shows a bright green commercial sign with large yellow text, followed by an address graphic overlay.

A woman's high-pitched laughter punctuates the background chatter, creating a lively, crowded market atmosphere. (4) A distinct, percussive 'crunch' sound is heard as the man bites into the food. He speaks with a mouthful, his voice slightly muffled but still clear, as he comments on the oiliness. The BGM remains at a steady volume. (5) Multiple voices join in a casual, excited conversation. There are audible reactions of 'Mmm!' and 'So oily!' from a second male and a female voice. The sound of plastic rustling is briefly heard as a cake is handled. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to document and review a popular street snack, 'corn cakes', in Chengdu. It uses high-energy narration and rapid visual cuts to showcase the cooking process, the volume of production, and the host's direct sensory reaction, particularly focusing on the greasy but sweet nature of the dish.
